evidence.note: InResponseTo echoes an AuthnRequest ID from another tab. The SP holds only one pending request ID, so the second tab's request overwrote or replaced the first.

output.fix: Don't store a single pending AuthnRequest ID per browser session. Keep a set of outstanding request IDs, keyed by the ID itself or by RelayState. Store them server-side or in a cookie that holds multiple entries. When a response arrives, look up its InResponseTo in that set, accept it only if found, and remove it after one use. Give each pending ID a short expiry. Keep the existing checks: signature verification against the configured IdP certificate, audience, recipient and time window. Don't disable the InResponseTo check. If IdP-initiated SSO is intended, enable it explicitly and separately.
